verdict.rationale: Exposing stored codes and secrets through a local API, CLI or agent endpoint is a fair axis for an authenticator or vault app, so it applies here. Nothing in the evidence shows Microsoft Authenticator offers any programmatic endpoint. The Screen Capture toggle only makes codes visible in screenshots, which is the screen-scraping the story wants to avoid. Password export is a one-off file dump, not a queryable interface, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose the vault through a local programmatic endpoint an agent can query for codes and secrets without screen-scraping the app
